credential_nft.aleo.notes: v1, @noupgrade, single-record mint to caller (employer only). Superseded by credential_nft_v2.aleo which emits dual records so workers see credentials in their own wallet.

credential_nft_v2.aleo.notes: @admin, dual-record mint but NO on-chain authorization check on mint — permissionless, anyone could fabricate credentials. Superseded by credential_nft_v3.aleo which adds employer_agreement_v4::assert_employer_authorized + two pnw_name_registry ownership checks on every mint.

credential_nft_v3.aleo.notes: @admin, dual-record mint + hard on-chain authorization. mint_credential_nft takes 13 inputs including agreement_id + parties_key + employer_name_hash + worker_name_hash as auth material. Cross-program calls: pnw_name_registry_v2::assert_is_owner(employer_name_hash, self.caller), pnw_name_registry_v2::assert_is_owner(worker_name_hash, worker_addr), and employer_agreement_v4::assert_employer_authorized (parties commitment + ACTIVE status). Unauthorized mints revert at the contract level. Depends on the 2026-04-12 upgrade of employer_agreement_v4.aleo (tx at15424d6swsselyrkmdv7gr2d2cql93rqjq0y3j25v3fzf4p79asgqzssqch) which added assert_employer_authorized.

employer_agreement_v5.aleo.notes: @noupgrade, edition 0, block 20793785. Compiled and tested with Leo 4.0.0 (22/22), deployed from that bytecode (deploy-new-program run 12, consensus version 22); the bytecode on chain matches main 633e45e byte for byte. 40.764508 credits: storage 28.516, synthesis 11.246508, namespace 1, constructor 0.002. Execution: create_offer 0.007735, accept_offer 0.007279, withdraw_offer 0.003059, pause 0.005272, resume 0.005369 (each approval 0.00428), terminate 0.00637, approve_end 0.00431, end_mutual 0.006401, assert_pair_active 0.0017, assert_pair_agreed 0.00178. Two-party: the P-256 public halves ride in the records, no registry call so no name hash or account in public inputs, SentOffer to the employer, no DAO copy; a pair tag (BHP1024 over the random parties_key and both accounts) carries the status for other programs; bytes packed as [u128; 2] / [u128; 4]; an agreement ends with a private reason; status 4 = withdrawn. docs/migrations/2026-10-23-agreement-v5.md. program_ids.layer1.employer_agreement stays v4 (the agreements already made) and employer_agreement_v5 is added beside it, as Hewn's packages/config/src/programs.ts has it; Hewn sends new offers here once it switches.

hewn_cards_v1.aleo.notes: Not deployed. @noupgrade, Leo v4.0, imports pnw_name_registry_v2 only. The cards every account gets (Hewn's docs/HEWN_ART.md): issue_business_card(name_hash, suffix_code) and issue_worker_card(name_hash, shown), once per .hewn name by its owner through the registry's assert_employer_owner (the industry code for a business, 0 for a worker); show_card / hide_card, a worker's switch. Public state: cards[name_hash] = { issued_at (block height, where time on Hewn counts from), shown }. No fee of its own. 22 Leo tests, 18 refusals.
